reviews.name: Miriam Sandoval
reviews.text: Angel and Dr. Chris are absolutely amazing! I never thought I'd get my tattoo removed and they just made me feel so comfortable and at ease with the process. They did everything to make me feel comfortable.

reply.text: Dear Miriam, thanks for the kind review. You dealt with the first session of tattoo removal like a champ! We are looking forward to caring for you in the future at our Safety Harbor, FL location.

reviews.name: Lexy Oler
reviews.text: I had such a great experience at Art Form Plastic Surgery in Safety Harbor! The office is beautiful, modern, and the entire staff was incredibly welcoming from the moment I walked in. Dr. K was amazing — very knowledgeable, thorough, and caring.

reply.text: Dear Lexy, thank you for the kind words. We love providing IPL service for Floridians who spend so much time in the sun. We are glad you enjoyed the Emage ImagePro face analysis as well.

reviews.name: Earle Hayes
reviews.text: Dr. Kieliszak is an amazing physician. He mixes medical skill with the art of medicine beautifully. He's thoughtful and knowledgeable and takes his time to assess and assure a great experience and outcome. Highly recommend him.

reply.text: Dear Earle, thank you for the feedback. At Art Form Plastic Surgery, we are happy to serve patients in Safety Harbor, Florida and the Tampa Bay area for all facial plastic surgery related concerns.

reviews.name: Tammy Turner
reviews.text: I had a microneedling treatment at this practice and I couldn't be happier. The doctor was professional, knowledgeable, and explained the whole process clearly, and the office staff were absolutely amazing — friendly, attentive, and supportive.

reply.text: Tammy, thank you for the kind review. At Art Form Plastic Surgery, we pride ourselves in clear communication and thoughtful treatment plans.

reviews.name: Marie Caplinger
reviews.text: Dr. Kieliszak was so wonderful to work with for my daughter's revision rhinoplasty/septoplasty. His personality and bedside manner are something to commend. His work turned out absolutely beautiful. Her breathing has also drastically improved. His follow-up care is top tier.

reply.text: Marie, thank you for the feedback! Dr. Kieliszak is a specialist in revision rhinoplasty procedures. We are glad your daughter had a great result and improved nasal breathing.

reviews.name: Dawn White
reviews.text: Had a great experience. Everyone was super helpful and the doctor was very nice and informative.

reply.text: Dawn, thank you for the feedback. At Art Form Plastic Surgery, we are available to care for patients in Safety Harbor, FL, the Tampa Bay area, and across the country.

reviews.name: Vanessa Watts
reviews.text: From the moment you walk in and are greeted by Angel you feel like you're at a spa, not an office! I am not new to injectables so I can say with confidence he's the best! I barely felt a thing! Dr. Kieliszak was thorough and explained everything clearly.

reply.text: Dear Vanessa, thank you for the positive feedback! What a testament coming from another medical professional. We are looking forward to caring for you as part of your ongoing treatment plan.

reviews.name: Wendi Newberry
reviews.text: I had laser resurfacing done. Initially I was nervous but Dr. K and his staff were extremely kind and accommodating! Dr. K went over everything so I understood the process. He was very kind and personable and checked up on me in the days to follow. The office was very organized and clean!

reply.text: Thank you Wendi for the feedback. At Art Form Plastic Surgery, we value caring for patients from Safety Harbor, FL, the Tampa Bay area, and across the country.

reviews.name: Dustin Myers
reviews.text: I had a great first session for tattoo removal today at Art Form Plastic Surgery in Safety Harbor. The office is beautiful, modern, and very welcoming. Dr. Chris Kieliszak was professional, knowledgeable, efficient, and made the entire visit comfortable.

reply.text: Thank you Dustin. We spent a lot of time designing our Safety Harbor, FL location to make it comfortable and accommodating for our patients.

reviews.name: Larry Miller
reviews.text: He did a good job and broke everything down step by step. Not once was he rough or disrespectful. I love his amazing work — he got me feeling better. Thank you!

reply.text: Thank you, Larry, for the kind review.

reviews.name: Kyle Schuttler
reviews.text: It was an amazing experience and the doctor did great. The staff treated me well and I have referred family members to the practice.

reply.text: Dear Kyle, thank you for the feedback. We greatly value caring for our patients and feel honored that you've referred your family members to the practice.

reviews.name: Robert Stafford
reviews.text: Dr. Kieliszak is an awesome doc. He took great care of me. He did the procedure under local anesthesia and I didn't need to go to the OR! So happy.

reply.text: Dear Robert, thank you for the kind words. Dr. Kieliszak prides himself in performing procedures under local anesthesia in addition to general anesthesia — it's all about the patient's comfort level.

reviews.name: Nancy Robinson
reviews.text: Very informative, and great bedside manner. My husband got great care and I am highly impressed.

reply.text: Thank you Nancy for placing your trust in Dr. Kieliszak to care for your family member.

reviews.name: Cheri Gangarossa
reviews.text: The doctor is very attentive and answered all my questions. I never felt rushed. He is very congenial, perceptive, and helped me through a variety of questions. He also provided great suggestions.

reply.text: Dr. Kieliszak prides himself in having a caring and congenial bedside manner. We are available for any additional facial plastic surgery related issues in the future.

reviews.name: Jennifer Young
reviews.text: Dr. Kieliszak helped my 16-year-old son with complications he was experiencing with his ear. He was very thorough with his explanations and options. Professional with impeccable bedside manner. Highly recommend his knowledgeable experience.

reply.text: Jennifer, thank you for the review. We are honored that you trusted us in caring for your son. Dr. Kieliszak is a specialist in ear-related surgical procedures.

reviews.name: Annette Wolfe
reviews.text: My husband had a procedure done at the office and it went very smoothly.

reply.text: Dr. Kieliszak prides himself in performing some procedures under local anesthesia in the office and makes it comfortable for patients. Thank you for the feedback.

reviews.name: Lynda Scott
reviews.text: I recommend this practice for aesthetic and cosmetic treatments. They do a great job and I would give 10 stars if I could!

reply.text: Thank you Lynda for the kind words.

reviews.name: Dianne Esdale
reviews.text: The doctor was very thorough and explained everything clearly. This is very important to me. The staff treated me well and I felt very comfortable — I would definitely recommend this practice.

reply.text: Thank you Dianne. Dr. Kieliszak and the staff pride themselves in making patients of Art Form Plastic Surgery feel comfortable at the practice.

reviews.name: Lola Shackelton
reviews.text: I had excellent service. The staff was exceptional and I am very thankful. Dr. Kieliszak did a great job.

reply.text: Lola, thank you for the feedback. We agree that we have the best staff!
